slides.label: Six times since 1600
slides.title:
As above,
so below
slides.subtitle:
The sky over us now has happened before;
here is what happened on the ground

slides.label: Where the words come from
items:
That which is above
is like to that which is below
Credited to Hermes · Arabic first, Latin by 1151
A person is a measure of the world

slides.label: In Jyotish
slides.title: The sky as a body
body:
Parashara reads the twelve signs as the body
of Time: Aries the head, Pisces the feet

Charaka maps the sky into you: the sun is your
power to take in, the moon your cheer, light
your knowledge, darkness your confusion

Varahamihira read the same sky for whole
countries: rain, harvests, famine and war
slides.closing:
The same grahas move
in a nation and in you

slides.label: We tested it · 1600 to today
slides.title: Six times before
slides.footnote:
Our engine checked every day since 1600:
the teacher (Jupiter) met the monk (Ketu)
in Leo, the king's palace, only six times before now

slides.label: What happened below
slides.title: 1635 and 1672
items:
Almost this exact sky, Mars close by, the Sun weak.
A preacher, Roger Williams, is banished for his beliefs
and founds Rhode Island on freedom of conscience

Saturn in Pisces, like now. France invades
the Dutch Republic; the Dutch still call it
the disaster year

slides.label: What happened below
slides.title: 1896 and 1932
items:
The same degree as this November. A man takes
Zanzibar's palace without approval; the war lasts
about 38 minutes. Famine and plague hit India

slides.label: The rhyme
slides.title: What repeats
items: The teacher turns monk: Williams, Gandhi

France across the Rhine;
Zanzibar's 38-minute war

Famine and fear, then a free colony,
a pact, a new deal

slides.label: November to January
slides.title: What to watch now
items: Especially 12 to 16 Nov, when Mars joins
Food and money worries in places

slides.label: As above, so below, so within
slides.title: In your own life
items: Don't take a seat you weren't offered
Keep a small reserve this winter

slides.title:
What does this sky rhyme
with in your life?
